name: ParaSwap Augustus V6 arbitrary-call approval drain
summary: AugustusV6.uniswapV3SwapCallback() did not verify that msg.sender was a genuine Uniswap V3 pool and trusted the caller-supplied data for the payer and token, so anyone could invoke it directly and make the router transferFrom any wallet that had approved it.
notes: The vulnerable callback executes in the diamond's own directly deployed runtime; later facet cuts did not select or replace that code.
ParaSwap reports approximately $24,000 lost in the initial malicious incident across four affected wallets and multiple EVM networks. Per-asset quantities are not published.
The official $24,000 loss is an approximate aggregate across four wallets and multiple EVM networks; per-asset quantities are not published.
